Email Triage Env

Classify, summarise, route and reply to enterprise emails across three difficulty tasks.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • LLM agent baselines

Reward

How it is scored
Programmatic check
Signal
Graded, 0 to 1

Keyword-based grader: label 0.50, summary 0.20, reply keywords 0.20, department 0.10, clipped to 0.01-0.99; no LLM judge.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

python server/app.py

2. Run the Space locallyevery Space is a Docker image or app you can clone

git clone https://huggingface.co/spaces/souller/email-triage-env
cd email-triage-env

The Space also runs live on the Hub; open it to see the API it serves.

Framework documentation: OpenEnv.

Evidence

Baseline table reports Qwen2.5-72B averaging 0.77 across tasks.

As reported by the publisher. We have not reproduced it.
